releases.title: Watch list, live suggestions, and personal ranking
items: New Watch List tab — reads the flagged titles that had been saving with nowhere to show them.
What's Next now rebuilds from your ledger every time you log something, instead of serving a frozen list.
Match scoring rebalanced: your favourites count far more than lukewarm entries, genre affinity is back, and dense clusters of cross-referencing docs no longer bury better matches.
New "Not interested" button, with undo and a reset.
My ranking sort — drag your own entries into the order you actually liked them. Feeds the suggestions.
Flagged titles leave What's Next and live on the Watch List instead.
Match badges are visible again; the trailer button had been covering them.
Service filter dropdown now fills in — it only ever offered "Any service".
Log a Film clears itself after saving, and defaults the date to today.
Watch dates no longer jump a day ahead when logging after 7pm.
Header shows when the site was last deployed, and what changed.
